units.rawText: Um... Hi, everyone. My name is Shale.

spans.text: Um... Hi, everyone. My name is Shale.

units.rawText: While I'm only now formally introducing myself, I'm very glad to be able to come to the Oasis and meet all of you. Please take care of me from now on!

units.rawText: (Yawn) I didn't expect the party to go on for so long.

spans.text: (Yawn) I didn't expect the party to go on for so long.

units.rawText: The Oasis really is filled with interesting people, and their food is really something... Meals were never this good back in Arcadia.
units.displayText: The Oasis really is filled with interesting people, and their food is really something... Meals were never this good back in Arcadia.

spans.text: The Oasis really is filled with interesting people, and their food is really something... Meals were never this good back in Arcadia.

units.rawText: There's nothing to complain about regarding the environment here and the friends I've made... The Professor really is amazing.

units.rawText: Nya...
units.displayText: Nya...

spans.text: Nya...

units.rawText: Pfft, looks like you two are all tuckered out. Have a good rest, okay... hm?

Dear Shale:<|>
Did you get my previous email? I entered the wrong name into the sender field. Still, by the time you open this, I'm sure you have made new friends. Are you happy?
